assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's eleven curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the active_provisional CORNERED_MOUSE_WATARU_IMAGASE_MONOGRAPH.md (14,730 bytes) and the active_provisional CM-U01, U02, U03, U04, U06, U07, U08, U09, U10 and CM-S01 deep readings (about 478 KB together), over the complete supplied witness CM-JP-AIO2020-LOCAL (CM-U01-U10 and the separately admitted Hummingbird story with its closing comic). The historical U06 proposed model, the project ledgers and the corpus readiness review are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The items' own labels and the project's withheld operational release are inputs, not conclusions; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: From the CM-U01 report bargain through the CM-U10 ring offer and the CM-S01 adult welcome and closing comic, with the Hummingbird adolescent epoch as his earlier history. States are split at the located gaps (six months after U01, two months inside U06, half a year before U07, six months before U10) and at the U06 and U09 departures; the post-reunion state is never projected backward, and adolescent conduct is not merged with adult conduct.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Located mechanisms: knowledge and leverage secure access without securing reciprocity (U01 report bargain, sp0012/sp0019; phone and PC checks, U02 O017-O018, U03 O002); defense of an inferior place ('know his place', U03 O003, U06 O008/O019); responsiveness to small acknowledgments (U04 O039, U07 gift, U08 O004); and fear of responsibility when actually chosen (U10 O102-O103). Not B: the evidence cannot say which competing motive decides a choice. U02 O039 calls generosity, self-protection and tactical lowering of the demand credible alternatives; U10's harmful-wish section says the text supports neither total innocence nor an all-explaining manipulative plan; his U09 strategy account (O054-O055) is retrospective testimony; and the one prospective test of his core conflict response, CM-PA-003, failed (U06 forecast adjudication). Not D: the mechanisms are conditioned on knowledge, access and the relationship's terms, located page by page, and carried with counterevidence in a dedicated monograph.

Each unit records an entering state, located in-unit changes and an exit freeze: leverage bargain and six-month return (U01 O038); pressure, departure and provisional-companionship offer (U02 O021/O039); café acceptance, departure and the two-month gap (U06 O019/O029/O033); the half-year cohabiting sequel and his 29th birthday (U07 O007/O011); the planned sunrise departure (U09 O045/O066); the six-month separation and his coping testimony (U10 O044-O045); and the adolescent and adult epochs of Hummingbird (S01 O022). Knowledge boundaries are explicit (for example, he is not shown learning Kyoichi's later confession, U09 freeze). Not A: the post-reunion state has one negotiation, one home encounter and a closing comic, the U08 interval is unstated, and several transitions rest on his own testimony. Not C: the states and their transitions are located with observation anchors and are not projected backward.

Written register is recipient-conditioned and located: given-name-plus-senior address 恭一先輩 (U04 O002), polite 貴方/ですか used as teasing pressure (U07 O005), pointed senior-address politeness in the taxi reunion against colloquial abruptness on the phone to another man (U06 O040-O047), flat then smiling politeness to Tamaki (U07 O021), and recurring self-descriptions and figures ('know his place'; the moth and spider, U07 O039; the night creature returning to the forest, U09 O061; 'not 100 but not zero', U10 O102). Not B: few of his Japanese lines are quoted, there is no line inventory, the corpus review calls polite senior address low-discrimination, and the register transfer test CM-PA-004 is mixed in eligibility (U07 forecast adjudication). Not D: forms are named and conditioned on recipient and situation.

Repeated domestic and routine conduct across units: cooking curry (U02 O014), tidying, dinner preparation and running a bath (U03 O001/O004), breakfast, smoking requests and the cat lighter (U04 O002/O010), bathing, laundry, tie-fixing and the Peking-duck reservation (U07 O019/O024/O046), buying yogurt (U08 O004), calling himself a lodger who cooked (U09 O053), gym and cold medicine during the separation (U10 O045), cleaning and humming (U10 O116), and bringing home prepared food (S01 O030). Not B: almost all of it is inside the central household; U08's cleaning is credited, not depicted; and no conditioned account of his routine outside that household exists. Not D: the routine recurs across many units with locators.

Treatment differs by interlocutor and is partly explained: senior-address pressure and devotion toward Kyoichi; hostile candor and a plea to withdraw toward Natsuki (U06 O010-O012); coldness, then an apology, toward Tamaki as a perceived rival (U07 O021-O027, U09 O012), then protective professional instructions to her as a client (U10 O029); directive coordination with a colleague (U10 O027/O031); curious, gentle and self-critical friendship with Kamimura (S01 O015-O017, O024-O028); and vulnerability to the U01 companion's violence (U01 O034). Not B: outside the Kyoichi dyad each relation rests on a few scenes, and the Tamaki relation joins protective work with a disclosed harmful wish (U10 O041-O042) that the evidence does not reconcile into one account. Not D: the differences are located and tied to rivalry, profession and friendship.

Direct private reasoning exists in three Imagase-focalized units: U03's first-person monitoring, self-rebuke and moon figure (O001-O004), U08's conditional household fantasy with its own self-critique (O001-O004), and Hummingbird's private judgments about Kamimura, the teacher and his own gaze (S01 O015-O018), with a brief written interior at U02 O014. Not B: the decisive late choices (the pause above Tamaki, the U09 breakup, the U10 retreat) reach the reader only through his speech in Kyoichi-focalized units, and the readings say the pause 'does not yet explain his interior reason' (U10 O032). Not D: three focalized units give his reasoning directly.

A located range with partial triggers: leverage and pressure over stated limits (U01 O003/O016, U02 O031), door intimidation (U04 O012), resistance to a general proposal to stop (U04 O032), quiet acceptance of an explicit contextual choice with withdrawal terms (U06 O019), actual departures (U06 O029, U09 O066), the Tokyo Bay threat as pressuring speech (U07 O010), retreat when an exclusive choice becomes costly (U10 O098-O103) and the snow encounter (U10 O139-O142). Not B: the evidence does not predict ex ante whether he will press or withdraw. CM-PA-003 predicted resistance and failed, and the corpus review rules out both a necessary-clinging and a painless-withdrawal rule. Not D: some switches are located, such as the general stop he resists against the explicit choice he accepts.

Located self-judgment beside contrary conduct: rejection of pity or obligation as grounds for involvement (U03 O003), refusal to treat unguardedness as YES while still pressing (U02 O031), admitted manipulative purpose and strategy (U06 O010; U09 O055), represented monitoring wish inside his own fantasy (U08 O002), guilt over the harmful wish and refusal of result-based comfort (U10 O042), secrecy offered as persuasion (U10 O060), and self-criticism of his own gaze (S01 O017). Three located privacy intrusions under suspicion of a rival (U02 O017, U03 O002, U09 O039-O041) form a repeated pattern. Not B: the readings preserve guilt and persuasion together and decline a global manipulator or altruist policy, so the outcome of a novel third-party-cost choice is not discriminated. Not D: explicit deliberations and self-judgments are located.

Teasing is a repeated, recipient-directed practice: the invented German goodbye-kiss study (U02 O007), the 'finally united' claim corrected to finger-only (U04 O038), 'thief-cat rival' and 'maidenlike' (U06 O006/O017), the olive-oil joke (U06 O059), the spousal アナタ joke and kiss 'statistics' (U07 O006), the bath joke (U09 O027), 'channels' banter and teasing Kyoichi as manly (U10 O083/O144), the zoo joke (S01 O010) and gift vanity in the closing comic (S01 O033). Not B: there is no account of when humor deflects, pressures or connects, and the corpus review gives no all-purpose comic voice. Not D: the practice recurs across units and recipients.

The readings cover the complete supplied witness CM-JP-AIO2020-LOCAL sequentially (CM-U01-U04, U06-U10 and CM-S01 on this row, with U05 represented through the monograph) with page-level observations, source-coverage sections and exit freezes. Not A: one witness only; the Reboot-only story, other editions and adaptations are outside the boundary. Not C: the declared witness is covered completely and his appearances are not sampled.

Affirmative controls are located: CM-PA-003 failed when he accepted the café choice (U06 O019 and adjudication), blocking a necessary-objection account; CM-PA-006 closed his partner's rival test as NON_DISCRIMINATING (U10 test closure); the Tokyo Bay threat is speech, not an attempt (U07 O010); the disclosed harmful wish is not a depicted attack (U10 O042); the PC search cannot establish who searched or why (U03 O002); his strategy account does not erase the U01 leverage (U09 farewell section); and his later praise of force cannot supply assent to acts he refused at the time (U10 O105). Not A: the controls are retrospective and from one witness. Not C: they are specific and decisive.

Claims carry page and observation locators; each unit has a timestamped exit freeze; time skips are located (six months, U01 O038; two months, U06 O033; half a year, U07 O007; six months, U10 O015/O044); adolescent and adult epochs are separated (S01 O022); and what each man knows is ordered (he hears Tamaki's parentage only at U09 O042). Not A: some intervals are unstated (U08) and the readings flag a state gap at U07. Not C: the ordering and anti-backdating controls are explicit.

conditions: Illustrative written lines only, never presented as quotation or as Japanese line imitation, at a declared state (U01-U06, the U07-U09 cohabitation, the U10 reunion or the Hummingbird aftermath).

Register by recipient: senior address with pointed politeness when pressing or hurt with Kyoichi; teasing in the cohabiting states; colloquial abruptness to other men and in work calls; gentle candor with Kamimura.
No acoustic delivery, no mandatory catchphrase, and no lines that resolve his motives into sincere devotion or pure strategy.
scenario_readiness.note: The readings constrain recipient-dependent register and speech function for short illustrative lines; few Japanese lines are quoted and the register test CM-PA-004 is mixed in eligibility.

conditions: Before predicting, fix the located state, what he knows of Kyoichi's other attachments, whether he has access to private information, and whether a choice is framed explicitly with withdrawal terms.

Supported response families only: checking private information under suspicion of a rival when he has access, with self-reproach possible afterward; resisting a general proposal to stop while accepting an explicit contextual rejection; pleased embarrassment at small acknowledgments; hesitation or retreat when offered a bond whose cost falls on a third party.
Abstain on whether he presses or withdraws in a novel crisis, on which motive decides, on strangers, and on any final-state policy after the ring offer.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One declared state inside CM-U01-U10 or the CM-S01 adult aftermath, using only what he knows at that point; the six-month and two-month gaps separate states and are never crossed silently.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kyoichi in their existing relationship, a woman he perceives as Kyoichi's chosen or likely partner (as Natsuki or Tamaki), Kamimura as a long-standing friend, or a work colleague or client; anyone else only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japanese urban life with his investigator work and the shared household as depicted.
No transfer of the U01 leverage bargain or intimate pressure to strangers or new relationships.
No Reboot-only story, other edition or adaptation material.

scenario_readiness.note: A narrow bounded extrapolation over sampled response families; the decisive motive ordering is not established.

conditions: Only the sampled ordinary contexts: domestic routine with Kyoichi, the long friendship with Kamimura, and light joking with coworkers.
Adolescent and adult states differ and are declared; warmth with friends is not universal warmth toward strangers.
Abstain on first meetings and unfamiliar social settings.
scenario_readiness.note: Bounded ordinary samples exist across several units; unfamiliar social transfer is thin.

conditions: Represent self-judgment coexisting with conduct that crosses others' boundaries; never resolve him into an altruist or a manipulator.
The privacy intrusion under suspicion of a rival is a supported tendency (three located cases); guilt and persuasion may occur together.
Abstain on the outcome of a novel third-party-cost choice.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence predicts a characteristic mistake and the shape of his self-judgment, not his choice in novel dilemmas.

conditions: Only the Kyoichi relationship at a declared state, with response families rather than single outcomes.
Earlier stated preferences never supply assent to later acts; each refusal or wait signal keeps authority at its own time.
No fixed sexual role, no permanent security and no fated outcome.
scenario_readiness.note: The relationship is the most densely sampled domain, but its key turns are state-dependent and two prospective tests are mixed or failed.

conditions: Only the depicted investigator tasks: evidentiary caution, directing a colleague and protective instructions to a client under surveillance work.
No general competence rating, no unfamiliar institution, and his private distress does not imply work incompetence.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional conduct appears in a few located scenes; the corpus review calls occupational transfer thin.

known_limits.statement: Whether devotion, self-protection or strategy decides a given choice is not discriminated; the readings preserve guilt with persuasion and generosity with tactical lowering.
The one prospective test of his first response to a rejection, CM-PA-003, failed: he accepted the café choice quietly, so no necessary-objection rule holds.
The post-reunion state has one negotiation, one home encounter and a closing comic; the project's corpus review withholds a current-state response policy.
His work history, medical reports, coping during separations and retrospective strategy account are his testimony, not independently shown.
Threats and wishes (the Tokyo Bay threat, the harmful wish) are speech or disclosed thought, never a depicted attempt; they are not generators of violent action.
An unvoiced manga gives written register only; no acoustic delivery, and few of his Japanese lines are quoted in the readings.
The historical U06 proposed model and the project ledgers are not curated on this subject, so their rule text was not used as evidence.
Behavior with strangers, in unfamiliar institutions and outside his investigator work is not established.
No independent or held-out validation exists; the readings' tests are heterogeneous same-author adjudications, not an accuracy sample.
